'''Dagger''' can refer to the following:

* ''[[The Great Hunt/Chapter 19|Beneath the Dagger]]'' - the ninteenth chapter of ''[[The Great Hunt]]''.
* ''[[The Path of Daggers]]'' - the eighth book in the ''[[Wheel of Time]]''.
* [[Dragon's Dagger]] - a mining complex in Kinslayer's Dagger.
* [[Dull dagger]] - a ''[[ter'angreal]]'' that causes whoever holds it to be invisible to [[Shadowspawn]] and possibly the [[Dark One]].
* [[Kinslayer's Dagger]] - an extension of the [[Spine of the World]].
* [[Ruby-hilted dagger]] - a cursed dagger from [[Shadar Logoth]].
